response.justification: Bogdan brings well over 8 years of broad software development experience and genuine developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial) and assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built and maintained CI/CD, GitLab, and deploy infrastructure, taught TDD/Selenium courses, and worked on an IDE (LabWindows/CVI) and mobile device orchestration tooling. That maps well to the engineering-productivity focus. However, the role is a people-leadership position requiring ~2 years of people management and 3 years of formal technical leadership, and his resume shows no management titles, no reports, and no evidence of performance reviews, hiring, or org-change leadership; Staff/Founder titles suggest influence but not documented people management. Mobile-platform depth is also thin (one iOS/tvOS stint a decade ago). Worth a screening call to probe informal leadership and mentoring scope, but he is not an obvious fit for a Level II manager role as written.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tooling and test-infrastructure background (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, DevOps)
13+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: workshops, conference talks, Selenium/TDD courses, dojos
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience or direct reports
Limited evidence of roadmap ownership, org change, or cross-team alignment at scale
Mobile-platform exposure is minimal and dated (iOS/Apple TV, 2015–2016)
